item.title: Top 5 Features of Azure SQL Database
item.description: Azure SQL Database offers a range of features that make it a preferred choice for cloud-based relational database management. This article explores the top five features of Azure SQL Database, highlighting its capabilities for modern application development. 1. Managed Service: Azure SQL Database is a fully managed service, which means that Microsoft takes care of routine database management tasks such as patching, backups, and monitoring. This allows developers to focus on building applications and delivering business value rather than managing infrastructure.

item.title: What Are Joins in Azure SQL Database
item.description: Joins play a crucial role in combining data from multiple tables in a relational database. This article delves into the concept of joins in Azure SQL Database, covering their types, syntax, and providing practical examples for effective data retrieval. 1. Types of Joins: Inner Join: An inner join returns only the rows that have matching values in both tables. It filters out the rows with no corresponding values in the joined table.
